cheap_local_cache_manifest.reason_cache_tensor_not_emitted: No active-site encoder cache builder exists in the current CLI, and this pass is limited to spec/report artifacts.

current702_data_readiness.readiness_rule: encoder_ready_minimal requires an entry in the geometry artifact, status ok, >=2 resolved active-site residues, >=1 role-annotated active-site residue, and >=1 pairwise active-site distance

edge_features.active_site_complete_graph: all ordered residue pairs among resolved active-site residues, capped at 20 residues per entry with deterministic source order
edge_features.direction_vectors: relative CA vector when both CA coordinates exist; otherwise centroid vector with coordinate_source flag

forbidden_predictive_fields: source IDs including entry_id/PDB/UniProt as categorical features
frozen_v0_feature_spec.graph_scope: active-site residues only; no full-protein residue graph in v0
frozen_v0_feature_spec.missingness_policy: do not impute target-derived features; emit masks and not_evaluable reasons. Single-residue rows may be used only by a node-pooling ablation, not by pair-distance/equivariant edge baselines.

node_features.amino_acid_residue_type: 20 standard residue one-hot plus unknown/nonstandard bucket from active-site residue code only
node_features.role_multihot: role vocabulary frozen from in_distribution encoder-ready rows; unseen heldout terms map to role_other

frozen_v0_feature_spec.normalization_policy: fit scalers and role vocabulary on in_distribution encoder-ready rows only; apply unchanged to heldout rows and report unseen/unknown rates

heads: parent_v1_label_group head: eight seed fingerprints plus out_of_scope/abstention behavior for result-card compatibility
binary in_scope_vs_out_of_scope calibration head for OOS false-positive tracking
proposal-only v2 auxiliary head trained/evaluated only where proposal labels are present; no canonical child metrics or imports
metrics: heldout primary-v1 accuracy and macro F1 on encoder-ready rows
OOS false-positive/non-abstention rate on heldout OOS rows
coverage-aware metrics that keep all 140 heldout rows in denominators via unavailable/not_evaluable counts
Wave 1 diagnostic cells: near-orphan geometry rescue, wrong-Foldseek-transfer behavior, dense-neighborhood behavior
delta vs Foldseek structural NN, active-site geometry retrieval baseline, Sequence-NN 3-mer, and available pretrained sequence representation tracks

result_card_output_contract.compatibility_note: shape mirrors Wave 1 diagnostic method_results/track rows and can be joined into a future result-card addendum without changing old outputs

split_and_seeds.hyperparameter_policy: fixed small grid chosen before looking at heldout; no large sweeps in v0

tracks.model: 3-4 layer GVP-GNN or equivalent local equivariant message-passing model over active-site residue nodes only
non-equivariant complete-graph baseline using distance-bin histograms, role/residue pooling, pocket descriptors, and cofactor bins
tracks.purpose: separate value of learned active-site locality from equivariance/model complexity

non_claims: No learned active-site encoder was trained.
No labels, registries, ontologies, thresholds, production scoring, imports, or existing model outputs were edited.
This artifact does not claim active-site learned features outperform Foldseek or pretrained representations; it defines the leakage-clean test track.

scope.target_question: Do active-site-local learned features add value beyond Foldseek, geometry retrieval, and pretrained sequence representations?
scope.wave1_split_policy: reuse frozen current702 Wave 1 sequence-distance split without reassignment

local_coordinate_directory.role: local mmCIF coordinate cache for staged selected structures; no downloads required for staged rows
